title: NERV shows FPV data through FPVBuddy's MCP tools and surfaces
goal: Battery data reaches NERV as FPVBuddy's surface-typed MCP results, rendered as bricks surface cards in chat, with FPVBuddy's MCP Apps page or link for the full screen; NERV hosts no FPV components of its own
acceptance: A chat question about batteries calls FPVBuddy's battery tools over MCP and the reply shows the result as a surface card rendered by the bricks surface components (web/src surface renderer), with invented data in tests
The full battery screen opens as FPVBuddy's MCP Apps page or link from the card; NERV keeps no copy of it
A test across the join: a fake FPVBuddy MCP server returns surface-typed battery data and the chat reply renders the card
Checked in a browser at desktop and phone width, light and dark

Replaces the 2026-11-20 plan to host the FPV core's web components in NERV's dashboard. Owner decision 2026-11-25 (coordinator docs/DOMAINS.md; FPVBuddy F-008-T07, FPVBuddy#13): each project owns its screens, built with bricks; NERV keeps no copies and shows other projects' data through MCP (genUI surface cards in chat; MCP Apps pages or links for full screens).
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-25 after the owner decision on screens: render FPVBuddy's surface-typed results with the existing surface renderer and link the MCP Apps page; no components to host. Was 1.5 h (host the core's web components). Not a measurement.
